abilities.name: Black Arrows
abilities.description: Basic Attacks infect enemies with Black Arrows for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Sylvanas deals 15% more damage to enemies with 3 stacks. Quest Damage Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. Upon damaging enemies 250 times, increase the damage bonus of Black Arrows to 50%. Reward Upon damaging enemies 400 times, Black Arrows now heals Sylvanas for 25% of damage dealt at 3 stacks, doubled against Heroes.; 40; trait

fields.notes: Walls do not give stacks for the quest. The effects of Black Arrows are applied before the damage is dealt. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Sylvanas's damage. The stack count of Black Arrows is shared among all Sylvanases in the team, and they can all refresh it, increment it and interact with it regardless of who placed it.

abilities.name: Withering Fire
abilities.description: Shoot the closest enemy up to 5 times over 1.5 seconds for 39 damage, prioritizing Heroes. Cooldown is reset on getting a Takedown.

fields.notes: Can only be activated if an enemy is within the radius. The Ability can not be activated again until all shots are used. If no enemy is in radius (while the Ability is active), a shot is consumed and the Ability continues until the end of its duration. Prioritizes the closest enemy in target groups of Heroes and non-Heroes. Other Structures are prioritized over Gates and Walls.

abilities.name: Shadow Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger at a target enemy that deals 30 damage and an additional 150 damage over 2.5 seconds. Damage dealt by Sylvanas to the initial target spreads Shadow Dagger to all nearby enemies.

fields.notes: 1) Spread radius is extended by the main target's unit radius. Cast is interrupted if the target moves at least 4 units past its range during its windup. Initial target is displayed by a unique icon overhead. Cannot spread to Stealthed enemy units, Walls, or enemy targets that are already affected by Shadow Dagger from the same Sylvanas. The initial damage instance is not classified as DoT and is dealt to secondary targets as well when Shadow Dagger spreads to them.

abilities.name: Haunting Wave
abilities.description: Send forth a wave of banshees, dealing 114 damage to all targets. Reactivate to teleport to the banshees' location.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.notes: 1) Search area expands to its maximum radius over 1.5 seconds in increments of 0.54. After the cast, the Ability can be reactivated for 1.75 seconds to launch to the wave's location. Sylvanas gains Unstoppable while she is traveling to the wave's location.

abilities.name: Wailing Arrow
abilities.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.; 90; 100; heroic

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk toward Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.; 40; 50; heroic

fields.notes: Mind Control is treated as a Silence effect. Abilities that interact with Silences also interact with Mind Control. Mind Controlled Heroes cannot attack and have no control of their movement.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 25 Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 3 charges.

fields.notes: Possession awards experience from the Minion kill (or the appropriate Regeneration Globe if the target unit is a Wizard Minion). Possessed Minions are restored to full Health and have negative effects removed from them, including the raven curse on Cursed Hollow. The enemy team does not get experience, Regeneration Globes or stacks from killing a possessed Minion and they cannot be repossessed by the opposing team's Sylvanas.

talents.name: Might of the Banshee Queen
talents.icon: Might of the Banshee Queen Icon.png
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

fields.notes: Spell Power from Might of the Banshee Queen stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Sylvanas's Spell Damage.

_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Unrelenting Torment
talents.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

fields.notes: Affects both the initial damage and the damage over time. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers affecting Shadow Dagger 's damage.

_raw_fields: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

talents.name: Overwhelming Affliction
talents.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

fields.notes: Slow is applied to the target for 3 seconds. This effect and its duration are separate from Black Arrows. Damage is dealt in a separate instance along with Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

talents.name: Unstable Poison
talents.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150 damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

fields.notes: If multiple Sylvanases are on a team, Unstable Poison only triggers from the effects placed by Sylvanases with this Talent. Activation through Black Arrows uses a separate counter that requires 3 stacks to be applied or refreshed by the same Hero.

_raw_fields: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150 damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

talents.name: Mercenary Queen
talents.description: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks Stun and instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to laning Mercenaries. Sylvanas deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

fields.notes: The Stun is applied for 3 seconds when attacking a Mercenary with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. This effect and its duration is separate from Black Arrows. Damage aura does not stack with other Mercenary Lord derivated damage auras. Otherwise, damage bonuses stack addtively with other offensive damage bonuses that can affect the target units' damage output.

_raw_fields: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks Stun and instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to laning Mercenaries. Sylvanas deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.
